info.name: Electro PI Task API
info.description:
# Electro PI Task API

Sanctum REST API for the Electro PI assessment.

## Quick flow
1. Login (demo) or Register — saves `{{token}}`
2. List Projects — saves `{{project_id}}`
3. Create / List Tasks — saves `{{task_id}}`

## Auth
`Authorization: Bearer {{token}}`
Send `Accept: application/json` on every request.

## Demo user
`demo@electro-pi.test` / `password`

## Filters (List Tasks)
`status`, `priority`, `search`
